The '''MEV2''', nicknamed "Dug Digger", was a [[Walker/Legends|walker]] digger manufactured and largely used by [[Corellia Mining Corporation/Legends|Corellia Mining Corporation]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
